* Auto Deploy Units & Auto Upgrade

  * Auto Upgrade Max Yen
  * Auto Upgrade All Units
  * Auto Vote
  * Auto Next/Replay/Leave
  * Game Speed (1x / 2x)

* Auto Summon
  * Auto Summon 1x
  * Auto Summon 10x

* Auto Sell
  * Auto Sell Rare
  * Auto Sell Epic
  * Auto Sell Legendary
  * Auto Sell Shiny
  * Auto Sell Mythic

* Auto Claim
  * Auto Claim Battlepass
  * Auto Claim Swarm Battlepass
  * Auto Claim All Quest

* Auto Quest
  * Auto Quest (Pucci / Dio / Aizen)

* Stage & Modes
  * Story Mode (World/Chapter Select & Start)
  * Ranger Mode (World/Act Select & Start)
  * Raid Mode (Raid/Act Select & Start)
  * Enter RiftStorm, BossRush, Infinite Mode, Swarm Event, Tournament

* Shop Automation
  * Auto-buy: Merchant Shop, Raid Shop, Raid Shop 2, Rift Storm Exchange, Fall Event Exchange

* Trait Reroll

* Crafting
  * Auto Craft (Select Item & Amount)

* Currency Info
  * Live display: Gems, Gold, Trait Reroll, Reroll Ticket, RC, Boss Rush, Rift Storm

* Discord Webhook
  * Send hourly banner info, summon results, stage rewards
